defs.def: a period of time in which sb is taught sth 一节课；一课时

ex.s: She generally works with their regular teachers to get lessons and tests being used at their home schools.
ex.t: 伊丽莎白·西姆斯分析了五部伟大小说的最后章节，看看它们包含哪些要点以及如何将其改编用于你自己的作品。

ex.s: Offering regular lessons.
ex.t: 它符合故事发展。

ex.s: The app makes our practical language lessons available wherever and whenever.
ex.t: 这款应用程序让我们的实用语言课程随时随地可用。

ex.s: Your guide will provide a history lesson about the trees and the famous monuments where they blossom.
ex.t: 你的向导会为你讲解这些树木的历史，以及它们盛开处那些著名纪念地的历史。

ex.s: A century ago, when life expectancy was lower and college education less prevalent, “the goal back then was survival, not violin lessons by 5,” Twenge said.
ex.t: 一个世纪前，当预期寿命更低、大学教育不那么普及时，“那时的目标是生存，而非5岁学小提琴，”特温格说。

ex.s: When I woke up the next day, there were still rules to obey and lessons to attend.
ex.t: 第二天我醒来时，仍然有规矩要遵守、有课要上。

ex.s: Each lesson lasts for 45 minutes.
ex.t: 每节课持续45分钟。

ex.s: Those letters taught my children a valuable lesson about writing: It has a purpose.
ex.t: 那些信给我的孩子们上了一堂关于写作的宝贵一课：写作是有目的的。

ex.s: However, her children have learned an important lesson witnessing their mother earn her degree.
ex.t: 然而，她的孩子们目睹母亲获得学位，学到了重要的一课。

ex.s: I learned this lesson from a（n）（2）     many years ago． I took the head（3）     job at a school in Baxley， Georgia． It was a small school with a weak football program．
ex.t: 多年前我从一个（2）___学到了这一课。我在佐治亚州巴克斯特的一所学校担任主（3）___的工作。那是一所橄榄球项目薄弱的小学校。

defs.def: something that is intended to be learned 课；教学单元

ex.s: Although not a morning person, I begin my lesson with Angela and about twenty others at a Sydney community centre courtyard at 7 am.
ex.t: 虽然不是早起的人，我还是在早上7点和安吉拉以及另外约二十人在悉尼一个社区中心的院子里开始上课。

ex.s: Note to teachers: Children’s Theatre has a study guide demonstrating how math and science can be taught through “Tom Sawyer.” For downloadable lessons, visit the official website of Children’s Theatre.
ex.t: 对教师的说明：儿童剧院有一份研究指南，说明如何通过“Tom Sawyer”教授数学和科学。 对于可下载的课程，请访问儿童剧院的官方网站。

ex.s: In addition to 31    skills, Pruitt's lessons teach teamwork, encourage self-worth, and promote feelings of community.
ex.t: 除了   31    技能之外普鲁特的课程还教授团队合作鼓励自我价值感并促进社区意识。

ex.s: I was 14 and having a French lesson.
ex.t: 我14岁，正在上法语课。

ex.s: In the summer holiday following my eighteen birthday, I took driving lessons.
ex.t: 在我刚过完十八岁生日的那个暑假里，我上了驾驶课。

ex.s: A local driving school has also offered him six    55    driving lessons.
ex.t: 当地一所驾校还为他提供了六节____55____驾驶课。

ex.s: I’ve also been taking driving lessons, and in fact I will be taking my driving test on the very day I turn 18.
ex.t: 我也一直在上驾驶课，事实上我将在满18岁的那天参加驾驶考试。

ex.s: I’ve been taking driving lessons for over a year, and still haven’t got my licence.
ex.t: 我已经上驾驶课超过一年了，还没拿到驾照。

ex.s: The weekly conversations between Mitch and Morrie result in series of lessons on the meaning of life and how best to live it.
ex.t: 米奇和莫里之间的每周对话产生了一系列关于生命意义以及如何最好地生活的课程。

ex.s: I managed to get an A in that   53  and learned life lessons that have served me well beyond the  54  .
ex.t: 我设法在那门___53___拿了A，学到的生活道理在我毕业后也一直受用。

defs.def: an experience, especially an unpleasant one, that sb can learn from so that it does not happen again in the future 经验；教训

ex.s: A Lesson from Kids
ex.t: 来自孩子的教训

ex.s: I wasn't going to let a grade stop me from learning some of the best lessons of my life.
ex.t: 我不会让一个年级 阻止我学习一些 我生命中最好的教训。

ex.s: Eric weiner’s The Socrates Express: In Search of Life Lessons from Dead Philosophers reawakened my love for philosophy.
ex.t: 埃里克·韦纳的《苏格拉底快车：从逝去的哲学家那里寻找人生教训》重新唤醒了我对哲学的热爱。

ex.s: Lessons of history are highly valued.
ex.t: 历史的教训受到高度重视。

ex.s: In Bellevue, the switch to adaptive signals has been a lesson in the value of welcoming new approaches.
ex.t: “它不能解决所有问题，但对较小的城市来说，自适应信号灯有一些好处，”他说。

ex.s: We don't have to live in the past, but we can definitely do better by learning from it and using the lessons learnt to lead more meaningful lives.
ex.t: 我们不必生活在过去，但我们可以通过从中学习并运用学到的教训来过上更有意义的生活，从而做得更好。

ex.s: China’s approach to protecting its environment while   70   (feed) its citizens “offers useful lessons for agriculture and food policymakers worldwide,” says the bank’s Juergen Voegele.
ex.t: 中国在保护环境的同时70（养活）公民的做法"为全球农业和食品政策制定者提供了有益的启示，"银行的Juergen Voegele说。

ex.s: Although my kindergarten experience feels like a century ago, the lessons I learned will stick in my mind forever.
ex.t: 虽然我的幼儿园经历感觉像是一个世纪前的事，但我学到的教训将永远留在脑海里。

ex.s: What lesson can we learn from the passage?
ex.t: 我们从这篇文章中可以学到什么教训？

defs.def: a passage from the Bible that is read to people during a church service （教堂礼拜中的）《圣经》选读
